review_scope: Validation, test and documentation defects in the archived M2b track; no scientific input, prior, likelihood, configuration value or published result changed

finding.summary: The archived track's 151 component tests could not fail on the scientific core.
probes_that_survived_the_pre_review_suit: delete the slope term from prior_kernel
remove the trapezoid half-cell edge weights in the process-grid prior
swap the time_bridge process/slope variance split

finding.interpretation: The archive reported correct publication facts, but its 'component outputs reproduced' evidence rested on tests that could not constrain the numbers.

interface_changes: tobac_supply.consumption_ledger.lawful_ledger requires an explicit keyword-only basis: SupplyBasis. Every in-repo call site passes one; src/tobac does not consume the ledger.
tobac_supply.longitudinal.rolling_origin_forecasts raises when min_train >= len(x) instead of returning an empty list.
tobac_supply.release_calibration.fit_release_process raises for a falsy non-grid argument instead of substituting ReleaseGrid().
run_manifest.json for both runners gains commit, command and worktree_dirty.
source_reconciliation.json now reports the config's five unresolved items instead of two.
scripts/run_empirical_longitudinal.py assembled_inputs takes keyword-only alignment and centre.
open_gates_after_this_review: strict_all (ruff --select ALL, BasedPyright strict over the tree) remains red.
CI regenerates the compact tables but does not diff them against results/longitudinal/; this receipt performed that comparison once by hand, it is not a gate.
The 2021 and 2022 documented windows overlap by 62 and 31 days; the overlap is recorded but no cross-period covariance is fitted.
SupplyBasis does not carry source IDs or observation dates, so duplicate conditioning of one MOH/NZHS source cannot be rejected at the ledger layer.
The archived track's 42-of-43 predecessor byte comparison and its 499 full-suite count still have no retained artefact; they are recorded as unverifiable local claims.
No independent scientific review, regulator approval or current-NZ posterior is claimed.

concurrency.note: Another workstream was editing the same checkout throughout. Only explicit paths were staged and committed; their uncommitted type-annotation, packaging and lockfile edits were never staged, reverted or included in PR #11.
